lesson.grammar_point: present perfect with just, already and yet (I've just bought, I've already repaired, I haven't packed yet, have you seen it yet?)

listenings.text: Hi Renato, it's Dana. Great session today. You looked strong in the water. Okay, I've just spoken to the organizers, and the date is official: Saturday the twenty-second, at Margaret River. I've already sent the new schedule to Bev, so she knows about the early mornings. Have you put the date in your phone yet? Do it tonight. Now, tomorrow after training, we're going to watch the replay together. Bring a notebook. I've already watched it twice, and I've got three ideas for your strategy. One more thing. Your fitness is good, but don't train extra on the weekend. Rest is part of the plan. See you tomorrow!

Hey mate, it's Kai. Quick question. Have you checked the van list yet? I've just added your name, but there are only five seats, and Jess hasn't confirmed yet. Oh, and I've already booked a cheap campsite near the beach, the same one as last time. Also, Tom has just made a countdown on the club page. Ten days to go! Everybody's already talking about it. Have you seen it yet? Okay, that's it. Call me back when you get this.

reading.rtitle: Semifinal Countdown: Ten Days to Go
paras: Good news, squad! The organizers have just announced the date of the Under 16 semifinals. They will be held at Margaret River on Saturday, the 22nd. That's ten days from today, and the countdown has already started.

Renato has already made a plan with Coach Dana. He has started a new schedule: fitness training on Monday and Wednesday, surf training on Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, and rest on Sunday. He has already repaired the ding on his board, and he has just bought a new leash.

But there is still a lot to do. Renato hasn't watched the full replay of his quarterfinal with Dana yet. They are going to watch it on Thursday and work on a strategy for the semifinal. He also hasn't seen the list of his opponents yet. The organizers will post it next week.
Kai has already booked the club van for the trip. "I'm a bit nervous," Renato told us, "but I've just read my checklist again, and I feel ready." Come to Margaret River and support him on the 22nd!
reading.source: Simulated club page post, written for this lesson.
